en.title: United pilots refuse ATC routing through severe thunderstorm and fly alternative route
en.summary: The crew of United flight 471 refused an air traffic control routing that would have taken their Boeing 737-700 through the worst part of a severe thunderstorm, and flew an alternative route with the backing of United dispatch.
body: A United Airlines Boeing 737-700 was scheduled to operate flight 471 from San Antonio to Washington Dulles (IAD) on Friday, November 6. After pushing back and while taxiing, the crew questioned the routing proposed by air traffic control, which would have taken the aircraft through the worst part of a severe thunderstorm. A recording shared by Aviation MP4 shows the pilot saying he would speak with United dispatch, and the crew refusing to fly through what would have been up to four hours of challenging weather, which they said would be demanding for the crew and uncomfortable for passengers. The report says the incident is believed to have taken place on November 6, but Simple Flying notes this has not been confirmed.

The crew asked to return to the initial routing, which would have taken the Washington-bound flight south of the severe weather. Air traffic control reevaluated the plan while the pilots spoke to dispatch, which backed the crew, noting they should not fly through the adverse weather, and the crew was ultimately permitted to fly an alternative route. Simple Flying reached out to United for comment, but had not received a response by the time the article was published.

Flight 471 is a daily service from San Antonio to Washington Dulles, scheduled to depart at 7:00 AM and arrive at 11:13 AM, with a usual flight time of two hours and 45 minutes; according to the pilot’s commentary in the recording, the proposed route through the thunderstorm would have added almost an hour of extra flying time. The episode illustrates the pilot in command’s final authority over the operation and safety of the aircraft: a pilot may reject a clearance believed to be unsafe, request an alternative, and declare an emergency and deviate from an air traffic control clearance without prior permission if safety is compromised.

facts.claim: United flight 471, a Boeing 737-700, was scheduled to operate from San Antonio to Washington Dulles on Friday, November 6, and the crew questioned the proposed routing while taxiing after pushback.
The proposed routing would have taken the aircraft through the worst part of heavy rain and thunderstorms, with up to four hours of challenging weather conditions.
The pilot said he would speak with United dispatch, and the crew refused to fly through the severe weather.

The crew requested the initial routing south of the severe weather, air traffic control reevaluated the plan, and United dispatch backed the crew, noting they should not fly through the adverse weather.
The crew was ultimately permitted to fly an alternative route.
The incident is believed to have occurred on Friday, November 6, but Simple Flying notes this has not been confirmed.
Simple Flying reached out to United for comment and had not received a response by the time the article was published.

Flight 471 is a daily service scheduled to depart at 7:00 AM and arrive at 11:13 AM, with a usual duration of two hours and 45 minutes, and the proposed route would have added almost an hour of flying time according to the pilot’s commentary in the recording.

The pilot in command holds final authority over the operation and safety of the aircraft and may reject an unsafe clearance, request an alternative, or declare an emergency and deviate from a clearance without prior permission if safety is compromised.

zh.title: 聯合航空機組拒絕穿越雷雨航路，改飛替代航線
zh.summary: 聯合航空471號班機機組在滑行期間拒絕航管提出的穿越雷雨航路，在簽派支持下改飛替代航線；機長對飛機安全握有最終決定權。
body: 聯合航空一架波音737-700原定11月6日星期五執行471號班機，由聖安東尼奧飛往華盛頓杜勒斯。班機推出並滑行時，機組對航管提出的航路提出質疑，指出該航路將穿越雷雨最劇烈的區域。一段由Aviation MP4分享的錄音顯示，機長表示將與聯合航空簽派聯繫，機組拒絕穿越最多可能持續四小時的惡劣天氣，認為這對機組是嚴苛考驗，也會影響乘客舒適度。報導指出，這起事件據信發生在11月6日，但Simple Flying表示尚未證實。
機組要求改回最初規劃、經雷雨區南側的航路；航管重新評估計畫，聯合航空簽派也支持機組決定，指出不應穿越惡劣天氣，最終機組獲准改飛替代航線。Simple Flying已向聯合航空詢問，至報導刊出時未獲回覆。
471號班機為聖安東尼奧至華盛頓杜勒斯的每日班機，表定上午7時起飛、上午11時13分抵達，全程通常2小時45分；依機長在錄音中的說法，穿越雷雨的航路將多花近一小時。事件凸顯機長對飛機運作與安全的最終決定權：機長可拒絕其認為不安全的航管許可、要求替代方案，安全受威脅時亦可宣布緊急狀態並逕行偏離航管許可。
